sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which natural object gives us heat and light during the day?
What is the main raw material used in factories to manufacture paper?
Which animal is mostly used for transport in hot desert lands?
Which of the following is a good habit for happy and healthy living?
options: C) Brushing teeth twice a day
questions.answer: C) Brushing teeth twice a day

questions.question_text: Which simple machine is used in a bicycle to make it move smoothly?
What do we call the different shapes of the Moon seen from Earth during a month?
In manufacturing, where are raw materials generally changed into finished useful products?
What type of houses are mostly built in regions that receive very heavy rainfall?
Which of these uses electrical energy to keep us cool during the summer?
Which planet in our solar system is commonly known as the Blue Planet?
Explain how raw cotton from a farm is changed into a shirt. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Raw cotton is first cleaned and spun into thin threads. These threads are then woven into cloth by machines and finally stitched to make a shirt.

questions.question_text: Why do people living in very cold regions wear heavy fur and wool? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: People in cold regions wear heavy fur and thick wool to trap their body heat. These clothes protect them from freezing winds and harsh snowfall.

questions.question_text: What is a constellation? Give one popular example. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A constellation is a group of bright stars in the night sky that forms a recognizable pattern or shape. The Great Bear is a popular example.

questions.question_text: State two healthy habits you should follow to keep your body strong. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: You should exercise daily by playing outdoor games and eat a balanced diet full of fresh vegetables. Getting enough sleep is also essential for staying strong.

questions.question_text: How does a pulley help us draw water from a deep well? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A pulley is a simple machine with a wheel and a rope. It makes work easier by changing the direction of the force needed to lift heavy water buckets.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are an astronaut stepping onto the Moon for the first time. Describe what you see around you in space. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I see a completely dark and silent sky filled with bright, unblinking stars. The Moon's surface is covered in grey dust and large craters. Looking back, I can see our beautiful Earth shining like a giant blue and white marble in the vast emptiness of space.

questions.question_text: Imagine you visit a large chocolate factory. Describe how the chocolate bars are being produced and packed by machines. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I see giant metal machines melting dark cocoa and sweet sugar into a thick, warm liquid. The liquid is poured into square molds and cooled down. Finally, robotic arms quickly wrap each solid chocolate bar in shiny foil and pack them neatly into large boxes.

questions.question_text: Explain why people living in different parts of the world eat different types of food and live in different houses. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: People live differently because of their local climate and geography. In hot, coastal areas, people build airy houses and eat fish and rice which are easily found. In snowy mountains, people build warm houses with sloping roofs to shed snow, and they eat hot, energy-rich foods to survive the freezing cold temperatures.

questions.question_text: Trace the journey of a wooden pencil, from a tree in the forest to the stationary shop. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, tall trees are carefully cut down in the forest and transported to a large factory. Huge machines slice the wood into thin pieces and hollow out a groove. A dark graphite core is placed inside, and the wood is glued together, painted brightly, and then shipped to local stationary shops.
